Q5460.reason: A painter’s out-of-court blame of coworkers for failing to reinforce a wall is not a vicarious admission under FRE 801(d)(2)(D) because wall reinforcement was outside the scope of his painting job, so the hearsay objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: Six weeks after a kidney transplant with OKT3 induction, fever, fatigue, and cold symptoms are a mono-like EBV illness (early PTLD risk), separate from the suspected rejection.

Q5849.reason: Testimony that computer records were kept on a regular business basis does not satisfy the full Rule 803(6) foundation or authentication, so the court will require more proof of reliability.
